text.content:
A junction dominated by a warped plank propped against one wall, covered edge to edge in chalk tally marks, two columns, both defaced by the other's supporters. At the top, barely legible under the scribbles: "GRULL'S LLAMA vs NAK'S LLAMA - SAME LLAMA - RACE DAY TBD."

GM Notes

Breather: No threat. This is the public face of the Room 4 substory - the whole warren is buzzing about it, and this board is where bets actually get placed.

Subquest - Place a Bet: If the party has learned about Spitfire and the two chiefs (Room 4), this is where that pays off - they can place their own bet (for or against either chief, or on "the llama wins for herself"), and whatever happens at the actual race should visibly settle accounts on this board afterward.
